title: Matter Printers
summary: Turns spare power into alloys, slowly. No deposit, no scars.
text:
The **Matter Printer** (after the research Isotope Cells) makes alloys out of power: no deposit, no mining, no scars on the land.

It is fussy about its power. It only takes power nothing else wants, and never draws on the batteries, so it runs on a surplus: geothermal, fusion or a sunny afternoon. When the colony is short, the printer is the first thing to wait.

- It works slowly, so think of it as a steady top-up, and the answer when the deposits run dry
- It costs isotopes to build
- Research Matter Compiler for more alloys from the same power
